answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks through multi-angle airspace attestation. Each node authenticates by tracking the flight path of a wild falcon using a sensor calibrated with a quartz prism. Treating identity as costless software is a computational fable; an attacker must deploy discrete optical hardware with physical line of sight instead of virtual instances. However, dense fog or raptor departure interrupts tracking, temporarily denying verification to valid agents.
